value.rationale: The dyadic depth is a natural logarithmic measure of proximity to the identity-trapping region. Its full-lag correlation and the Nq critical crossover quantify residence-induced memory on a timescale not determined by the stationary density or the bounded coordinate observable. The natural complete statistics illuminate an exact intermittency mechanism without an arbitrary parameter slice.
